name: BFCToken
fix_description: Business logic flaw in _transfer: the complex fee/reward distribution logic (involving _distributeRewards, updateUserAmountMint, updateUserAmountBurn) has an accounting inconsistency that allows attackers to extract more value than intended through specific transaction patterns.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving a flash swap, fee-on-transfer token behavior, repeated pair balance manipulation via transfer/skim, and final unwind through router swaps. It requires understanding PancakeSwap pair mechanics and protocol-specific token logic, but the attack path is still fairly self-contained and not deeply cross-protocol or mathematically complex.
